FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 68
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Kenyatté Hassell
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 68 as introduced could increase the obligations of Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an undetermined amount to provide for the voluntarily designation of
certain medical conditions on an individual's driver license or identification
card.
